text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки does great at the Asahi Hai
F.S.,
boosting everyone's expectations
of her
becoming the next Triple Crown
Champion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A flood of reporters rush to her for
interviews,
but she handles them all with
practiced ease and
coolness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She wants to gain more experience
racing in a big
event before the Satsuki
Sho, so we decide to
take on the Yayoi
Sho next.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
